results.name: independent_j08_close_reopen_blocks_old_read_and_submit
results.evidence: A queued preview from a closed import produced no request. The reopened dialog previewed only the new filename and record. Cancel preserved the store.

results.name: independent_j08_explicit_format_while_read_pending
results.evidence: User-selected grouped FASTA took precedence over automatic extension selection. Both source records and the original CRLF bytes reached the grouped preview; cancellation preserved the store.

results.name: independent_j08_replaced_invalid_utf8_cannot_report_stale_error
results.evidence: Late decode failure from the replaced file left the newer preview and status untouched and produced no writes.
